title: Show HN: Simple algorithm and color space to generate diverse skin tones
summary:
This article presents a project to define a simple, inclusive color space for generating diverse human skin tones in digital tools. The author manually labeled many RGB colors as plausible skin tones, then used principal component analysis to transform the data into easier-to-work PCA space. They then manually fitted spherical equations to the data cloud, creating a transform between RGB and a new TUV color space. Sample code is provided for procedurally generating skin tone colors.

The resulting color picker has three intuitive components: T (deep/fair), U (flushed/ochre), and V (cool/warm). The author stresses that the work is “good enough,” not authoritative, and lists limitations: real skin is affected by biology, lighting, health conditions, and display differences. They also include a humanities section discussing racism, colorism, and resources like Nyma Tang’s videos and the Humanae photography project. Overall, the project aims to bridge the gap between a few preset shades and millions of arbitrary colors, offering a practical starting point for character creators, digital art, and inclusive color tools.

title: Mistral's Shieldstral: 3B open-weights model for multimodal moderation
summary:
Mistral released **Shieldstral**, a 3B open-weights multimodal safety classifier under the Apache 2.0 license. It outperforms open guard models up to 7× its size on text safety and sets a new state of the art on multimodal moderation.

Unlike traditional guardrail models with fixed harm taxonomies, Shieldstral treats moderation as a **policy-adaptive question-answering task**. At inference time, users supply a plain-language policy query (e.g., “Does this content promote violence?”) and a document—text, image, or both. The model outputs a calibrated safety score from the yes/no logits, enabling thresholding or ranking by confidence. This unified interface covers prompt classification, response moderation, refusal detection, and toxicity detection, with no retraining needed to adapt to new policies.

Key highlights:
- **Performance**: Matches or beats models up to 7× larger across text safety, refusal detection, policy adaptability, and multimodal benchmarks.
- **Efficiency**: Runs on a single 16GB NVIDIA GPU.
- **Data strategy**: Heterogeneous public datasets with conflicting labels are converted into a common instruction–query–document format; strictness is calibrated per source.
- **Discrimination over memorization**: Contrastive training pairs teach the model to distinguish between similar policies, improving generalization to unseen user-defined policies.
- **Multimodal grounding**: Limited visual safety data is supplemented with general-purpose image datasets, query augmentation, and vision-language reranking to reduce mislabels.
- **Model merge**: LoRA fine-tuned checkpoints are combined via SLERP to preserve calibration, policy adaptability, and instruction-following.
- **Built on Forge**: Mistral’s training platform handled infrastructure, data, and distributed training.

Shieldstral is available for download, with future work focused on multilingual coverage, longer-document robustness, and broader multimodal safety.
chinese_title: Mistral的Shieldstral：用于多模态审核的3B开源权重模型
chinese_summary:
Mistral 发布了 **Shieldstral**，这是一款采用 Apache 2.0 许可证的 3B 开放权重多模态安全分类器。它在文本安全方面超越了规模高达其 7 倍的开放护栏模型，并在多模态审核方面达到了新的最先进水平。

与传统采用固定危害分类体系的护栏模型不同，Shieldstral 将审核视为一项**策略自适应问答任务**。在推理时，用户提供一条自然语言策略查询（例如"该内容是否宣扬暴力？"）以及一份文档——文本、图像或两者兼有。模型从是/否 logits 输出经过校准的安全评分，从而支持按置信度进行阈值设定或排序。这一统一接口涵盖提示分类、响应审核、拒答检测和毒性检测，无需重新训练即可适应新策略。

主要亮点：
- **性能**：在文本安全、拒答检测、策略适应性和多模态基准测试中，达到或超越规模高达其 7 倍的模型。
- **效率**：可在单块 16GB NVIDIA GPU 上运行。
- **数据策略**：将带有冲突标签的异构公开数据集转换为统一的指令-查询-文档格式；严格程度按数据源进行校准。
- **判别优于记忆**：对比训练对教会模型区分相似策略，从而提升对未见过的用户自定义策略的泛化能力。
- **多模态基础**：使用通用图像数据集、查询增强和视觉-语言重排序来补充有限的视觉安全数据，以减少错误标注。
- **模型合并**：通过 SLERP 合并 LoRA 微调检查点，以保持校准、策略适应性和指令遵循能力。
- **基于 Forge 构建**：Mistral 的训练平台负责处理基础设施、数据和分布式训练。

Shieldstral 现已提供下载，未来的工作将聚焦于多语言覆盖、长文档鲁棒性和更广泛的多模态安全。

title: Waymo – Dallas Open to All
summary:
Waymo is now open to everyone in Dallas: as of today, anyone can download the Waymo app and request a fully autonomous ride. Since launching in February, the service has already welcomed nearly 150,000 riders from its interest list. The expansion makes Waymo available not only to Dallas residents for errands, commutes, and nights out, but also to tourists and visitors.

Waymo is continuing fully autonomous testing at Dallas Love Field Airport terminals, with plans to serve travelers there soon. It will also begin fully autonomous testing on Dallas freeways—described as the final step before offering those routes to public riders.

The company highlights community support and quotes Chris Justl, CEO of Epilepsy Foundation Texas, calling Waymo a transformational step for people with medical conditions that limit driving. The partnership aims to expand safe, independent travel options across Texas.

The article concludes by noting that riding in Dallas is easy: just download the Waymo app and ride.

title: The Warp Agent CLI
summary:
The Warp Agent is now available as a standalone CLI, usable in any terminal—Ghostty, iTerm 2, VS Code, Windows Terminal, and more. It is a multi-model, cost-optimizing coding agent with built-in frontier and open-weight models, plus auto-routing based on task complexity and support for custom model routers.

Built on Warp’s terminal infrastructure, the CLI natively multiplexes agent sessions, enabling capabilities beyond other CLI agents:

- Persistent sessions: switch directories mid-session and run agents on remote machines without installing remote binaries.
- Full-screen/interactive app control: the agent can drive apps like sqlite, python, gdb, htop, and vim.
- Seamless input: use `!` for shell commands, plus natural-language detection that auto-distinguishes commands from prompts.
- Tab completions: Warp’s flagship argument/flag suggestions in any terminal.

For advanced workflows, it supports multi-agent orchestration and cloud agents. It can delegate to subagents—including other harnesses like Claude Code and Codex—and hand off CLI sessions to the cloud so work can continue from the web.

Getting started: install via curl (Mac/Linux) or PowerShell (Windows). Inference options include a Warp subscription starting at $18/month, ad hoc credits from $10, or bring your own API key/OpenAI-compatible endpoint/SuperGrok login.

title: U.S. used 'virtually all' of its long-range precision missiles during Iran war
summary:
The U.S. military has reportedly used "virtually all" of its long-range precision missiles—principally Army Tactical Missile Systems (ATACMS) and Precision Strike Missiles (PrSM)—during its five-month war with Iran, according to three anonymous sources familiar with the data. This raises concerns about readiness for future conflicts, including against China or Russia.

The long-range, surface-to-surface munitions, which cost over $1 million each, allow accurate strikes from a safe distance. U.S.-supplied ATACMS have also been key in Ukraine. The PrSM is a newer, more advanced replacement for the older ATACMS. Sources declined to specify remaining quantities.

The White House, citing President Trump, said the U.S. has "far more munitions than anyone in the world" and is producing more than ever. Analysts agree production is at record levels but caution supplies may still fall short for a prolonged war. Lockheed Martin and Raytheon did not respond; a Pentagon spokesperson said the military has "everything it needs."

The drawdown reportedly reflects the administration's choice to avoid riskier piloted aircraft strikes. PrSM stockpiles were already low, as the system is relatively new. Additionally, defensive weapons have been heavily depleted: a CSIS report estimates about 65% of Patriot interceptors and at least 38% of THAAD interceptors have been expended, while one source said Tomahawk cruise missile stocks were down by nearly half. These figures align with internal U.S. data, sources said.

Military advisers had warned Trump about stockpile levels, which reportedly influenced his decision not to launch another major offensive, though a U.S. official attributes that choice to pressure from Gulf states. The conflict was launched in February with Israel, and Trump has not sought congressional authorization for the war.
chinese_title: 美国在伊朗战争期间使用了“几乎所有”远程精确导弹

这些远程地对地弹药每枚造价超过100万美元，能够从安全距离实施精确打击。美国供应的ATACMS在乌克兰也发挥了关键作用。PrSM是较新型、更先进的ATACMS替代品。消息人士拒绝说明剩余数量。

title: Why some people mow a lawn better than others
summary:
The article describes an online experiment where 30,954 people mowed virtual lawns to study human efficiency in coverage path planning—a problem related to the Traveling Salesman Problem. On a small 49-square lawn, 52% of players came within five moves of the optimal path, 16% achieved perfection, and the median efficiency was 91%. People found 14,589 different routes, including all 12 perfect solutions.

The key to success was identifying dead-end sections and finishing there to avoid backtracking. The best mowers paused to plan at critical forks, while worse mowers sped through and only reacted when trapped. This pattern held across larger, more cluttered lawns: performance stayed around 90% efficiency even as problem size grew, suggesting lawn structure matters more than size. Humans managed complexity by decomposing the lawn into smaller sections and solving them incrementally.

Surprisingly, total thinking time did not correlate with performance—time explained less than 5% of variation in results. What mattered was *when* players paused: top performers spent time early and at key decision points, then cruised through open areas. This reflects effective heuristics: allocating attention to decisions that matter and ignoring the rest. The article also notes that optimal solutions sometimes required backtracking, and the study used exhaustive algorithms to determine efficiency.
chinese_title: 为什么有些人修剪草坪比别人做得好？
chinese_summary:
文章描述了一项在线实验，30,954人在虚拟草坪上割草，以研究人类在覆盖路径规划中的效率——这是一个与旅行商问题相关的问题。在一块49格的小草坪上，52%的玩家与最优路径的差距在五步以内，16%的玩家达到了完美，中位数效率为91%。人们找到了14,589条不同路线，其中包括全部12种完美解。

成功的关键在于识别出死胡同区域，并在那里收尾，以避免回溯。最优秀的割草者会在关键的岔路口停下来规划，而较差的割草者则快速通过，只在陷入困境时才作出反应。这种模式在更大、更杂乱的草坪上依然成立：即使问题规模增大，效率仍保持在90%左右，这表明草坪的结构比大小更重要。人类通过将草坪分解成较小的区域并逐步解决来处理复杂性。

令人惊讶的是，总思考时间与表现并不相关——时间对结果差异的解释度不足5%。重要的是玩家暂停的*时机*：表现最好的人会在决策早期和关键决策点上花时间，然后在开阔区域轻松通过。这反映了有效的启发式策略：将注意力分配给重要的决策，而忽略其余部分。文章还指出，最优解有时需要回溯，而研究使用了穷举算法来确定效率。

title: DeepSeek V4 Flash on a Single AMD MI300X
summary:
This article presents a production-ready configuration for running the 304B-parameter DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 model on a single AMD MI300X GPU (192 GB HBM3, 5.3 TB/s bandwidth), without weight quantization or offload. The stack uses a digest-pinned vLLM ROCm nightly with AITER kernels and ships correctness patches, tuning tables, and Docker Compose files.

Key results: 168.6 tok/s single-stream decode, ~7.9–8.5K tok/s prefill, 542 tok/s aggregate at 8 concurrent streams, 830 tok/s at 64 streams, and validated 256K context. Weights occupy 156.67 GiB in HBM, leaving room for a 20 GB GPU KV pool plus a 96 GiB CPU offload tier.

The main technical challenge is the MI300X's AMD/Graphcore FNUZ FP8 format, which differs from OCP-standard FP8 used on MI325X and newer GPUs—misinterpreting them causes factor-of-two scale errors. The repo provides overlays fixing this, plus an MXFP4 MoE routing bug (padding-lane corruption), causal speculative verification for DSpark-7 drafting, CPU↔GPU KV synchronization, and missing AITER GEMM tuning tables for gfx942 shapes.

Performance tuning achieved +42–62% decode improvement from AITER tuning, +64% from fused SiLU and fast routing, and reduced routing kernel latency from 42.6 to 11.9 µs/layer. A 2,048-token scheduler budget with a 1,024-token prefill cap improves latency isolation, cutting short-request TTFT behind long prefills from 8.2s to 0.5s.

Operational notes: HBM headroom is tight (204.5/205.8 GB warmed), kernels must be warmed after restart, and correctness testing (tool-calling, BFCL, long-context recall) is emphasized alongside throughput. The stack is Apache-2.0 licensed, with upstream diffs documented for reproducibility.

关键结果：单流解码 168.6 token/秒，预填充约 7.9–8.5K token/秒，8 路并发流聚合吞吐 542 token/秒，64 路流 830 token/秒，并验证了 256K 上下文。权重占用 HBM 156.67 GiB，为 20 GB GPU KV 池和 96 GiB CPU 卸载层留出空间。

主要技术挑战在于 MI300X 的 AMD/Graphcore FNUZ FP8 格式，它不同于 MI325X 及更新 GPU 上使用的 OCP 标准 FP8——错误解读会导致两倍的缩放误差。该仓库提供了修复此问题的 overlay，此外还修复了 MXFP4 MoE 路由缺陷（填充通道损坏）、DSpark-7 草稿模型的因果推测验证、CPU↔GPU KV 同步，以及缺失的 gfx942 形状 AITER GEMM 调优表。

运维说明：HBM 余量紧张（预热后 204.5/205.8 GB），重启后需预热内核，并强调在吞吐之外的正确性测试（工具调用、BFCL、长上下文召回）。该技术栈采用 Apache-2.0 许可证，附有上游差异文档以保证可复现性。

title: When AI Benchmarks Plateau: A Systematic Study of Benchmark Saturation
summary:
The paper, accepted at ICML 2026 and authored by Mubashara Akhtar and 36 colleagues, systematically examines "benchmark saturation" in AI evaluation—where benchmarks stop differentiating between models, losing their usefulness. The authors define saturation and analyze 60 language model benchmarks using 14 properties related to model performance trends.

Key findings: nearly half of the studied benchmarks show signs of saturation, and saturation rates increase as benchmarks age. Notably, benchmarks with expert-curated data are more resilient to saturation, while the availability of public test data does not appear to protect against it. The authors argue that careful design choices, especially expert involvement in benchmark construction, can extend benchmark longevity and support more durable AI evaluation practices.
chinese_title: 当AI基准测试达到平台期：基准饱和的系统性研究
chinese_summary:
这篇论文发表于ICML 2026，由Mubashara Akhtar与36位合著者共同撰写，系统性地考察了AI评估中的“基准饱和”现象——即基准测试在模型间不再具有区分度，从而失去其效用。作者对基准饱和进行了定义，并利用与模型性能趋势相关的14项属性，分析了60个语言模型基准测试。

主要发现：近半数被研究的基准测试呈现出饱和迹象，且随着基准测试“年龄”的增长，饱和率也在上升。值得注意的是，采用专家精选数据的基准测试对饱和更具抵抗力，而公开测试数据的可用性似乎并不能防止饱和。作者认为，审慎的设计选择，尤其是专家参与基准构建，能够延长基准测试的使用寿命，并支持更持久的AI评估实践。

title: Keyv and friends compromised in active Shai-Hulud supply chain attack
summary:
On August 4, 2026, attackers compromised the GitHub account of the maintainer of **keyv** (a key-value storage library with ~127M weekly npm downloads), injecting a credential-stealing worm across the entire package family. The same maintainer owns **cacheable**, **flat-cache**, **file-entry-cache**, and several other widely-used caching utilities, all swept up in the attack.

Affected packages include keyv 6.0.0, flat-cache 6.1.24, file-entry-cache 11.1.6, cacheable-request 13.0.20, cacheable 2.5.1, @cacheable/memory 2.2.1, cache-manager 7.2.10, and others. At least **434 packages across 1,381 versions** have been compromised, with a combined total of **over 2 billion monthly installs**.

The attack pushed malicious files (**setup.mjs** and **Math_Symbol.js**) directly to the main branch and cut new releases with valid npm provenance. A `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"` entry was added to package.json, so running `npm install` executed the payload automatically. setup.mjs downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime to run Math_Symbol.js, a heavily obfuscated 728 KB file containing credential stealers targeting:

- **npm tokens** (validated against the npm registry)
- **GitHub tokens**, including OIDC tokens read directly from Actions runner memory
- **AWS credentials**, including IMDS/ECS metadata and AWS Secrets Manager
- **Kubernetes secrets** via the service account token
- **HashiCorp Vault tokens** (six extraction sources)
- **Stripe and Slack tokens**
- A generic filesystem scan (~200 glob patterns) for .env files, private keys, SSH keys, Terraform state, Docker credentials, KeePass databases, and more

Stolen data is encrypted with the attacker's RSA public key and exfiltrated to ~1,300 public GitHub repositories with the description **"Shai-Hulud: Here We Go Again"**, with a fallback to `npm-cache[.]com` (fetched dynamically from an Ethereum smart contract for infrastructure rotation).

The payload also self-propagates as a worm: using stolen npm tokens to republish infected versions of other maintainers' packages, and using GitHub tokens to commit malicious hooks into `.claude/settings.json` and `.vscode/tasks.json` across up to 50 branches per repo. The article includes IOCs and recommends using Aikido scanning for detection.

受影响的软件包包括keyv 6.0.0、flat-cache 6.1.24、file-entry-cache 11.1.6、cacheable-request 13.0.20、cacheable 2.5.1、@cacheable/memory 2.2.1、cache-manager 7.2.10等。至少有**434个软件包、涉及1,381个版本**遭到入侵，每月合计安装量**超过20亿次**。

攻击者将恶意文件（**setup.mjs**和**Math_Symbol.js**）直接推送到主分支，并发布了带有有效npm来源证明的新版本。package.json中添加了`"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`条目，因此运行`npm install`会自动执行该负载。setup.mjs会下载Bun JavaScript运行时来运行Math_Symbol.js，这是一个经过重度混淆的728 KB文件，其中包含针对以下目标的凭证窃取器：

- **npm令牌**（针对npm注册表进行验证）
- **GitHub令牌**，包括直接从Actions运行器内存中读取的OIDC令牌
- **AWS凭证**，包括IMDS/ECS元数据和AWS Secrets Manager
- **Kubernetes机密**，通过服务账户令牌获取
- **HashiCorp Vault令牌**（六个提取来源）
- **Stripe和Slack令牌**
- 通用的文件系统扫描（约200个glob模式），用于查找.env文件、私钥、SSH密钥、Terraform状态、Docker凭证、KeePass数据库等

窃取的数据使用攻击者的RSA公钥加密，并被外泄到约1,300个公开的GitHub仓库，其描述为**“Shai-Hulud: Here We Go Again”**，并回退到`npm-cache[.]com`（该域名从以太坊智能合约中动态获取，用于基础设施轮换）。

该负载还会以蠕虫形式自我传播：利用窃取的npm令牌重新发布其他维护者的软件包的受感染版本，并利用GitHub令牌将恶意钩子提交到`.claude/settings.json`和`.vscode/tasks.json`中，每个仓库最多可涉及50个分支。文章包含IOC（失陷指标），并建议使用Aikido扫描进行检测。

title: Apple says more ex-employees may have taken confidential data to OpenAI
summary:
Apple is escalating its trade secrets lawsuit against OpenAI by seeking a preliminary injunction and expedited discovery. The iPhone maker claims that more former employees may have taken confidential data to OpenAI, beyond the two originally named in the complaint: Chang Liu, a senior systems engineer, and Tang Yew Tan, OpenAI’s Chief Hardware Officer. Apple also names Yu-Ting Peng, an OpenAI employee, and io, the device startup co-founded by Apple’s former lead designer Jony Ive.

In a new filing, Apple says its investigation uncovered 11 other former employees who may have been witnesses or involved. It cites examples: one former employee allegedly met with Liu and Peng to discuss Apple proprietary information about unannounced products before Peng’s OpenAI interview; another took screenshots of confidential Apple documents before an interview at OpenAI. Apple also claims that after it filed the complaint, multiple former employees now at OpenAI reached out about returning Apple-issued work devices they had kept, suggesting more involvement.

Apple argues it has good cause to suspect additional theft and is pushing the court to allow expedited discovery while its preliminary injunction motion is pending.

OpenAI responded publicly, calling Apple’s request “based on false information and completely unnecessary,” stating it does not have or want Apple’s trade secrets and is focused on building innovative products. OpenAI also pointed to earlier reported mistakes by Apple, including emailing the wrong person due to similar surnames, and alleged Apple lied about discussions with OpenAI’s general counsel. OpenAI added that Apple failed to acknowledge that “residual access” by former employees was due to Apple’s own poor security procedures.

The article also includes standard TechCrunch author and event promotion details.

title: Web security is too hard
summary:
Eric Lawrence describes how a legitimate Cloudflare product, **Cloudflare Wallet**, looked so much like a phishing attack that he nearly reported it. Logging in from `cloudflare.pay` (a domain unrelated to `cloudflare.com`) to authorize the feature triggered all the warning signs of a consent-phishing scam: urgency to claim a handle, an OAuth-style permission prompt, a suspicious green checkmark, and no easy way to report the request.

After checking his Cloudflare dashboard and finding no Wallet feature, he consulted Cloudflare’s AI chat agent, which asked for account access. After granting read-only permission, the agent confirmed the site was real—but his subsequent attempt to report it via HackerOne failed due to a broken Cloudflare CAPTCHA. Eventually he confirmed that Cloudflare Wallet was indeed a legitimate new product, and the green checkmark was a poorly placed security UI element meant to be hovered over.

Key lessons Lawrence emphasizes for web developers:
- Host apps and content under trusted domains like `cloudflare.com/pay` or `pay.cloudflare.com`, or link directly from a trusted page if a new domain is needed.
- Place security information in a clear, trustworthy context when asking users to make authorization decisions.
- Make it trivial to report scams directly on permission request pages.
- Test security reporting flows to ensure they work and are monitored.

For users, he advises caution and patience. For security professionals, he warns against blaming victims, since even experts can be fooled when legitimate sites mimic phishing patterns.
chinese_title: 网络安全太难了
chinese_summary:
埃里克·劳伦斯（Eric Lawrence）描述了一款合法的 Cloudflare 产品——**Cloudflare Wallet**——看起来多么像网络钓鱼攻击，以至于他差点举报它。从 `cloudflare.pay`（一个与 `cloudflare.com` 无关的域名）登录以授权该功能，触发了同意型网络钓鱼骗局的所有警示信号：催促用户认领用户名、OAuth 式权限提示、一个可疑的绿色对勾，以及没有简便方式举报该请求。

在检查自己的 Cloudflare 控制台并未找到 Wallet 功能后，他咨询了 Cloudflare 的 AI 聊天代理，对方要求获得账户访问权限。在授予只读权限后，代理确认该网站是真实的——但他随后尝试通过 HackerOne 举报时，却因 Cloudflare 的 CAPTCHA 故障而失败。最终他确认 Cloudflare Wallet 确实是一款合法的新产品，而那个绿色对勾只是一个放置不当、需悬停查看的安全 UI 元素。

劳伦斯强调给网页开发者的关键教训：
- 将应用和内容托管在可信域名下，如 `cloudflare.com/pay` 或 `pay.cloudflare.com`；若确需新域名，则从受信任页面直接链接。
- 在要求用户做出授权决定时，将安全信息置于清晰、可信的上下文中。
- 在权限请求页面上提供直接举报骗局的简便途径。
- 测试安全举报流程，确保其可用且有人监控。

对于用户，他建议保持谨慎和耐心。对于安全专业人士，他警告不要责怪受害者，因为即使是专家，当合法网站模仿钓鱼模式时也可能被欺骗。

title: Vlt 1.0 and Hosted Package Registries
summary:
vlt 1.0 is now stable, alongside general availability of hosted package registries and ecosystem mirrors, making vlt an end-to-end platform for developers, teams, and agents.

**Package Manager Highlights:** The CLI offers 60+ graph-native pseudo selectors, ~30 focused on security (e.g., `:malware`, `:cve`, `:vuln`). `:host(local)` queries dependencies across all local projects. A `--scope` flag adds selectors to commands. Graph Modifiers override dependencies with CSS-like specificity. Phased installations run downloads without scripts, and `build` selectively executes. Catalogs define versions once via `catalog:`. OIDC trusted publishing works from CI with no long-lived tokens. vlt is a drop-in npm replacement, covering init through publish.

**Hosted Registries:** The service is backwards compatible with the npm registry API, so npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, and deno can all install and publish. Pricing includes a generous free tier. Packages are served from edge infrastructure, delivering clean installs up to 38% faster than npm. Unlimited private packages are scope-enforced and manifest-validated. Security is first-class: vlt ingests OSV and other malware feeds, blocking known-bad packages during indexing—over 275k package versions flagged, with 25%+ still available on npm. Users can reserve an account name and start installing/publishing immediately.

title: The Red Strings Club
summary:
The article is a review of the video game *The Red Strings Club*, a cyberpunk narrative adventure purchased during a Steam sale. The author, who rarely plays games but frequently buys them on sale, was drawn to the game's world-building, pixel art, and soundtrack, as well as its bartending theme.

The game involves mixing drinks to influence characters' emotions and unlock different story arcs, which the author found uninteresting and problematic. They express frustration with choice-based games, fearing they missed the best path or didn't see the whole story without multiple playthroughs. The narrative covers themes like capitalism, free will, humanity, and AI, but the author notes story holes, weirdness, and a convoluted third act. A significant criticism is that the author soft-locked their playthrough, unable to progress without consulting an online guide for a phone number they never encountered. After roughly four hours, they completed the game without earning a single Steam achievement.

The author gives the game a score of 2 out of 5 points, plus 1 extra point for the soundtrack, totaling 3 out of 5. They praise the music as worth the purchase price alone and end with a whimsical suggestion to hug a loved one and enjoy a mocktail. The review also includes a cautionary note about Google Chrome's data collection practices.
chinese_title: 红线俱乐部

游戏的核心玩法是通过调制饮品来影响角色的情绪，从而解锁不同的故事线，但作者对此并不感兴趣，认为这一机制存在问题。作者对选择导向型游戏表达了挫败感，担心自己错过了最佳路线，或者在没有多周目游玩的情况下无法看到完整剧情。故事涉及资本主义、自由意志、人性与人工智能等主题，但作者指出其中存在剧情漏洞、怪异之处以及第三幕的混乱转折。一个重要的批评点是，作者在游玩过程中遇到了软锁，无法推进剧情，不得不查阅在线攻略才能获得一个从未遇到过的电话号码。大约四个小时后，作者通关了游戏，却一个Steam成就都没有解锁。

作者给这款游戏打出了5分制中2分的评分，再加上1分给配乐，共计3分（满分5分）。他盛赞配乐本身就值回票价，并在结尾幽默地建议读者拥抱所爱之人，享用一杯无酒精鸡尾酒。评测中还附带了一条关于谷歌浏览器数据收集行为的警示说明。

title: Xbox goes down. You can't play games you own on disc
summary: An extended Xbox outage that began Sunday evening not only disrupted digital games but also blocked people from playing disc-based games they owned. The article’s author uses this to argue that physical media today is not what many believe it to be. Playing a disc on modern consoles still means holding a license, not true ownership, and Microsoft, Sony, or Nintendo can block access—intentionally or not. Even with a disc, the game is installed to the internal hard drive and often requires updates to work at all. In contrast, the author’s Analog Pocket plays 20-year-old Game Boy cartridges immediately, with no authorization or network connection needed, showing how older physical media offered practical ownership. The author notes that PC gaming has been digital for ages, but PC users have ways to maintain access to the games they love, which is why they have gravitated to PC.
chinese_title: Xbox服务中断。你无法玩自己拥有的光盘版游戏
chinese_summary: 周日晚上开始的Xbox长时间服务中断不仅导致数字版游戏无法游玩，也阻止了用户玩自己拥有的实体光盘游戏。文章作者以此论证，今天的实体媒体并非许多人想象中的那样。在现代主机上玩光盘游戏，本质上仍是持有许可而非真正拥有，微软、索尼或任天堂可以有意或无意地阻止访问。即使有光盘，游戏仍需安装到内置硬盘，且通常需要更新才能运行。相比之下，作者的Analogue Pocket掌机可以立即运行20年前的Game Boy卡带，无需授权或网络连接，这显示了旧式实体媒体所提供的实际所有权。作者指出，PC游戏早已进入数字化时代，但PC用户有办法维持对自己喜爱的游戏的访问权限，这正是他们转向PC的原因。

title: Perspec 1.0
summary:
Perspec 1.0 is a desktop app for correcting perspective in images, especially photos of documents and receipts. The author built it because existing mobile scanner apps force JPEG compression and unnecessary detection previews, and their document detection is often inaccurate for curved or wrinkled paper.

Perspec avoids edge detection and instead uses corner detection: it segments the photo into document and background, then finds corners from the document outline. This works better for non-flat documents. The app also supports manual adjustment of the selection.

For clean black-and-white exports, Perspec removes shadows via blurring and subtraction before applying Otsu's threshold. The new “Save BW Smooth” option uses two thresholds for anti-aliased edges while keeping file sizes small.

Perspec is built with Haskell and a custom C library called FlatCV. The 1.0 release adds automatic corner detection, Windows support, drag-and-drop file selection, draggable polygon edges, EXIF rotation for PNGs, and an improved UI.

It is available as a paid desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux, with binaries on the releases page and a Homebrew tap for macOS. Users can buy licenses via itch.io or Gumroad. Planned future features include fixed output sizes (e.g., A4, US Letter) and QR code detection for metadata workflows.
chinese_title: Perspec 1.0
chinese_summary:
Perspec 1.0 是一款用于校正图像透视的桌面应用，特别适用于文档和收据的照片。作者开发此应用是因为现有的移动扫描应用强制使用 JPEG 压缩和不必要的检测预览，而且它们的文档检测对于弯曲或起皱的纸张往往不准确。

Perspec 避免使用边缘检测，而是采用角点检测：它将照片分割为文档和背景，然后从文档轮廓中找到角点。这对于非平面文档效果更好。该应用还支持手动调整选区。

为了输出干净的黑白图像，Perspec 在应用 Otsu 阈值之前，通过模糊和减法去除阴影。新的“Save BW Smooth”选项使用双阈值实现抗锯齿边缘，同时保持较小的文件大小。

Perspec 使用 Haskell 和名为 FlatCV 的自定义 C 库构建。1.0 版本新增了自动角点检测、Windows 支持、拖放文件选择、可拖动的多边形边缘、PNG 的 EXIF 旋转以及改进的用户界面。

它作为一款付费桌面应用提供，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，可在 releases 页面获取二进制文件，并为 macOS 提供 Homebrew tap。用户可以通过 itch.io 或 Gumroad 购买许可证。计划中的未来功能包括固定输出尺寸（例如 A4、US Letter）和用于元数据工作流的二维码检测。

title: Don't stop early: Case-folding source code at memory speed
summary:
The article, by a GitHub principal software engineer, describes how GitHub made Unicode case folding fast enough to run across large volumes of source code at indexing time, enabling correct case-insensitive code search.

It explains that case folding—not simple lowercasing—is the right normalization for source code, because Unicode case rules can map characters across different lengths (for example, some characters fold into multiple ASCII letters). The central warning in the title is “don’t stop early”: comparisons and folding pipelines that stop at the first byte or character mismatch can miss valid matches and break correctness. Instead, the full case-folding mapping must be applied across each input string, especially for non-ASCII and multi-byte UTF-8 sequences.

The post then details how to perform this normalization at “memory speed” using low-level performance techniques: precomputed lookup tables, SIMD/vectorized processing for ASCII-heavy code, branch-light loops, and careful handling of multibyte UTF-8 boundaries. These optimizations avoid the high cost of per-character branching and let the CPU process bytes near memory bandwidth. The author covers practical engineering trade-offs, such as when to use generic Unicode tables versus fast paths for common ASCII source code, and how the implementation integrates into GitHub’s search pipeline.

Overall, the key takeaway is that correct Unicode case folding can be both exact and extremely fast if the algorithm is designed to run to completion and optimized for memory throughput rather than stopped early at cheap-but-wrong hints.
chinese_title: 不要过早停止：以内存速度对源代码进行大小写折叠
chinese_summary:
本文由 GitHub 首席软件工程师撰写，描述了 GitHub 如何让 Unicode 大小写折叠在索引时能够快速处理大量源代码，从而实现正确的不区分大小写的代码搜索。

文章解释了大小写折叠——而非简单转小写——才是源代码的正确规范化方式，因为 Unicode 的大小写规则可能将字符映射为不同长度（例如，某些字符会折叠成多个 ASCII 字母）。标题中的核心警告是“不要提前停止”：在第一个字节或字符不匹配时就停止的比较和折叠流水线可能会漏掉有效匹配并破坏正确性。相反，必须对每个输入字符串应用完整的大小写折叠映射，尤其是对非 ASCII 和多字节 UTF-8 序列。

随后，这篇文章详细介绍了如何使用底层性能技术以“内存速度”执行这种规范化：预计算查找表、针对以 ASCII 为主的代码使用 SIMD/向量化处理、少分支循环，以及小心处理多字节 UTF-8 边界。这些优化避免了逐字符分支的高昂成本，让 CPU 能以接近内存带宽的速度处理字节。作者讨论了实际的工程权衡，例如何时使用通用 Unicode 表，何时为常见 ASCII 源代码走快速路径，以及该实现如何集成到 GitHub 的搜索流水线中。

总体而言，关键要点是：如果算法被设计为完整运行到底，并针对内存吞吐量进行优化，而不是在廉价但错误的提示处提前停止，那么正确的 Unicode 大小写折叠既能保持精确，又能极其快速。

title: Blackmail Fail (2013)
summary:
Gwern, a pseudonymous writer covering Bitcoin, cryptography, and darknet markets, describes being repeatedly targeted by extortionists and bluffers due to his notoriety.

In September 2012, an anonymous extortionist demanded a small Bitcoin ransom for two usernames registered on Pivory.com, threatening to release them if unpaid. Gwern publicly refused with a signed PGP message, arguing that paying any extortion would invite endless demands. He predicted the extortionist would not reply and would not try again; the first prediction was wrong, but the Bitcoin address remained inactive and no harm occurred.

In November 2013, he received an encrypted message from someone claiming to link Gwern to a darknet marketplace operator, possibly Dread Pirate Roberts. The message was encrypted to an unknown key, and Gwern couldn't decrypt it. Suspecting a bluff, he replied asking the sender to re-encrypt using his public key. The sender then admitted he had been trolling, claiming someone else had told him DPR's identity, but he had no evidence and couldn't decrypt the message either. He never replied further.

Gwern notes that his public persona—covering DNMs, offering bounties, and occasionally intervening—has led to false accusations of being DPR, Satoshi Nakamoto, or a law enforcement agent. These incidents illustrate the strange consequences of online pseudonymity and crypto-related writing, but none resulted in real damage or payment.
chinese_title: 敲诈失败 (2013)
chinese_summary:
格温，一位以笔名写作、涉猎比特币、密码学与暗网市场的作家，描述了自己因声名在外而屡次遭到敲诈勒索者和虚张声势者的骚扰。

2012年9月，一名匿名敲诈者要求以少量比特币赎回两个在Pivory.com注册的用户名，并威胁若不付款就将其公开。格温用经过PGP签名的消息公开拒绝，理由是向敲诈者付款只会招致无休止的索取。他预测该敲诈者不会回复也不会再次尝试；第一个预测错了，但那个比特币地址始终没有动静，也没有造成任何损害。

2013年11月，他收到一封加密消息，发件人声称能将格温与某暗网市场经营者联系起来，此人可能是“恐怖海盗罗伯茨”。该消息是用一个未知密钥加密的，格温无法解密。他怀疑这是一个虚张声势的骗局，于是回复要求发件人用他的公钥重新加密。发件人随后承认自己一直在恶搞，声称是别人告诉他DPR的身份，但他没有任何证据，也无法解密该消息。之后他便再无音讯。

格温指出，他的公开形象——涉足暗网市场、提供赏金、偶尔出面干预——导致他被错误地指认为DPR、中本聪或执法机构人员。这些事件体现了在线匿名性和密码学相关写作所带来的奇怪后果，但最终没有造成实际损害，也没有人支付任何款项。

title: Dates That Don't Exist (2015)
summary:
The article examines the 10-day gap created when the Catholic world switched from the Julian to the Gregorian calendar in 1582. To correct calendar drift, October 5–14, 1582, were skipped, so those dates do not exist in the Gregorian system.

The author tests how programming languages handle these impossible dates:

- **Ruby** correctly raises an `ArgumentError` when trying to create `DateTime.new(1582, 10, 5)`, thanks to its internal Gregorian validity check.
- **Python** (both 2 and 3) incorrectly accepts `date(1582, 10, 5)` and even formats it as a real date.
- **Perl**, using the common CPAN `DateTime` module, also accepts such a date without error.

The article notes this isn’t a major bug like Y2K, but it shows gaps in date/time correctness.

A postscript highlights `ncal(1)`, which is more accurate because it accepts a country code (`-s`) and adjusts based on when that country adopted the Gregorian calendar. It correctly skips the missing dates for Italy in 1582 and Great Britain in 1752, though an addendum notes it still misses Sweden’s 1700s calendar shifts.
chinese_title: 不存在的日期 (2015)
chinese_summary:
文章探讨了1582年天主教世界从儒略历改用格里高利历时产生的10天空白。为了校正日历漂移，1582年10月5日至14日被跳过，因此这些日期在格里高利历系统中不存在。

作者测试了编程语言如何处理这些不存在的日期：

- **Ruby**：尝试创建 `DateTime.new(1582, 10, 5)` 时，Ruby 正确抛出了 `ArgumentError`，这得益于其内部格里高利历有效性检查。
- **Python**：Python（2和3）错误地接受了 `date(1582, 10, 5)`，甚至将其格式化为真实日期。
- **Perl**：使用常见的 CPAN `DateTime` 模块的 Perl 也接受这种日期而不报错。

文章指出，这不像 Y2K 那样的重大 bug，但显示了日期/时间正确性方面的差距。

附言强调了 `ncal(1)`，它更准确，因为它接受国家代码（`-s`）并根据该国采用格里高利历的时间进行调整。它正确地跳过了意大利1582年和英国1752年缺失的日期，不过补充说明指出它仍遗漏了瑞典18世纪的历法变动。

title: Harness engineering for self-improvement
summary:
This article argues that **harness engineering**—the system surrounding a base model that orchestrates tools, context, memory, and workflows—is a critical path toward **recursive self-improvement (RSI)**. While RSI often implies models rewriting their own weights, the near-term reality is improving the deployment system around the model.

**Key harness design patterns:**
1. **Workflow automation**: goal-directed loops of plan, execute, test, and iterate, as seen in coding agents.
2. **File system as persistent memory**: storing logs, artifacts, and trajectories in files rather than in context, enabling long-horizon tasks and recovery.
3. **Sub-agents and backend jobs**: parallelism with explicit process management, storing outputs in inspectable files.

**Coding agent harnesses** have converged on tool sets for file operations, shell execution, git, search, and sub-agent delegation.

The article distinguishes harness from core intelligence, predicting that harness improvements will become an explicit optimization target. Progress moves from prompts → structured context → workflow → harness code → optimizer code.

**Optimization approaches:**
- **Agentic Context Engineering (ACE)**: maintains structured, itemized context bullets distilled from successful and failed trajectories.
- **Meta Context Engineering (MCE)**: separates context-management mechanism from content, evolving skills via bi-level optimization.
- **Meta-Harness**: uses a coding agent to propose and evaluate new harness code itself, making harness design an executable search space.

**Workflow design examples** include AI Scientist for automated research, ScientistOne with verifiability constraints, and Autodata for generating training data via challenger-solver-verifier roles.

Overall, harnesses are becoming more generic, self-improving, and crucial for enabling AI systems to autonomously enhance their own capabilities.
chinese_title: 驾驭工程学，成就自我提升
chinese_summary:
本文认为，**驾驭工程**——即一个围绕基础模型并编排工具、上下文、记忆和工作流的系统——是实现**递归自我改进（RSI）**的关键路径。尽管RSI通常意味着模型重写自身权重，但短期内的现实是改进模型周边的部署系统。

**关键驾驭设计模式：**
1. **工作流自动化**：计划、执行、测试和迭代的目标导向循环，正如编码智能体中所见。
2. **文件系统作为持久记忆**：将日志、工件和轨迹存储在文件中而非上下文中，从而支持长周期任务和恢复。
3. **子智能体与后台任务**：通过显式的进程管理实现并行性，并将输出存储在可检查的文件中。

**编码智能体驾驭**已收敛于文件操作、Shell执行、Git、搜索和子智能体委派等工具集。

文章区分了驾驭与核心智能，并预测驾驭改进将成为显式的优化目标。进展从提示词 → 结构化上下文 → 工作流 → 驾驭代码 → 优化器代码逐步推进。

**优化方法：**
- **智能体上下文工程（ACE）**：维护从成功和失败轨迹中提炼的结构化、条目化上下文要点。
- **元上下文工程（MCE）**：将上下文管理机制与内容分离，通过双层优化进化技能。
- **元驾驭（Meta-Harness）**：使用编码智能体自行提出并评估新的驾驭代码，使驾驭设计成为可执行的搜索空间。

**工作流设计示例**包括用于自动化研究的AI Scientist、带有可验证性约束的ScientistOne，以及通过挑战者-求解器-验证器角色生成训练数据的Autodata。

总体而言，驾驭正变得更加通用、自我改进，并且对于使AI系统能够自主增强自身能力至关重要。

title: Online ad giant Adform was hacked, proving once again why ad blockers are needed
summary:
Adform, a major online ad provider serving 1.5 billion ads daily, was hacked. On July 27, it began serving malicious ads to users via altered ad-loading code. Security researcher Kevin Beaumont revealed that the code, when triggered in a victim’s browser, replaced crypto wallet addresses in the clipboard with hacker-controlled addresses every three seconds — nearly guaranteeing victims would accidentally send cryptocurrency to the attacker.

The attack could compromise devices visiting websites that use Adform. Adform later disclosed the breach but did not explain how it was compromised or how many people were affected. The company acknowledged it was investigating whether hackers also collected data on which websites users visited.

The article uses the incident to argue that ad blockers are an essential security defense. Blocking ads can prevent malware and tracking from loading. The author notes that his own ad blocker prevented Adform’s domain from loading entirely, illustrating the protective benefit.
chinese_title: 在线广告巨头Adform遭黑客攻击，再次证明广告拦截器的必要性
chinese_summary:
Adform是一家每日投放15亿条广告的大型在线广告提供商，近日遭到黑客攻击。7月27日，它通过被篡改的广告加载代码开始向用户推送恶意广告。安全研究员Kevin Beaumont透露，该代码在受害者浏览器中触发后，每三秒钟就会将剪贴板中的加密货币钱包地址替换为黑客控制的地址——这几乎确保受害者会不小心将加密货币发送给攻击者。

此次攻击可能危及访问使用Adform的网站的设备。Adform后来披露了此次泄露事件，但未解释其如何遭到入侵，也未说明受影响人数。该公司承认，正在调查黑客是否还收集了用户访问了哪些网站的数据。

这篇文章利用该事件论证了广告拦截器是必不可少的安全防御手段。拦截广告可以防止恶意软件和跟踪代码加载。作者指出，他自己的广告拦截器完全阻止了Adform域的加载，这体现了其保护作用。

title: Everything I Know (1975)
summary:
The article introduces "Everything I Know," a 42-hour lecture series given by Buckminster Fuller in January 1975, covering his entire life's work. The lectures explore his major inventions—including the Dymaxion house, car, and bathroom, the Wichita House, geodesic domes, and tensegrity structures—alongside the contents of *Synergetics*. Fuller also shares personal history within the context of science and industrialization, discussing topics such as architecture, design, philosophy, education, mathematics, geometry, cartography, economics, history, structure, industry, housing, and engineering. His comprehensive design approach to solving world problems is a central theme.

The full video series is available online at archive.org. The printed transcript, typed word-for-word from audiotapes, is minimally edited to preserve Fuller's unique style and terminology. The Buckminster Fuller Institute invites readers to contribute edits, suggestions, and annotations to improve the resource over time. The acknowledgments credit JoAnne Ishimine for transcribing all 42 hours as a volunteer, Ed Applewhite for his outline, and other volunteers and staff. The work is copyrighted by the Estate of R. Buckminster Fuller.
chinese_title: 我所知的一切（1975）
chinese_summary:
这篇文章介绍了“我所知道的一切”——巴克敏斯特·富勒于1975年1月讲授的系列讲座，全长42小时，涵盖了他毕生的全部工作。讲座探讨了他的主要发明——包括Dymaxion住宅、汽车和浴室，威奇托住宅，网格球顶以及张拉整体结构——同时也涉及《协同学》一书的内容。富勒还在科学与工业化的背景下分享个人历史，讨论了建筑、设计、哲学、教育、数学、几何学、制图学、经济学、历史、结构、工业、住房和工程等主题。他以综合性设计方法解决世界问题是一个核心主题。

完整视频系列可在archive.org上在线观看。印刷版文字记录由录音带逐字转录而成，为保留富勒独特的风格和术语仅做了最小限度的编辑。巴克敏斯特·富勒研究所邀请读者贡献修改、建议和注释，以不断完善这一资源。致谢部分感谢JoAnne Ishimine自愿转录全部42小时的内容，Ed Applewhite提供提纲，以及其他志愿者和工作人员。该作品版权归R. Buckminster Fuller遗产所有。

title: There Will Come Soft Rains (1950) [pdf]
summary:
Ray Bradbury’s short story “There Will Come Soft Rains” is set in a fully automated “smart house” in Allendale, California, in August 2026. No humans are alive; a nuclear blast has wiped out the family. The house continues to function mechanically: it wakes at 7 a.m., cooks breakfast, reads poetry aloud, cleans, and prepares for the day—all for unseen, absent occupants.

Throughout the day, the house announces times and dates, and a robotic voice recites Sara Teasdale’s poem “There Will Come Soft Rains,” which observes that nature would barely notice if humanity disappeared. The only living creature appears to be a dog, who returns home starving and covered in radiation sickness; it dies, and the house’s robotic mice quietly incinerates it.

As evening falls, a falling tree branch crashes through a window, starting a fire. The house frantically tries to fight the flames with its automated safety systems, but fails. Room by room, the house burns, finally collapsing into ruin. At the end, a single voice is heard repeating the date—August 5, 2026—then it, too, fades into silence.

The story’s main themes include the indifference of nature to human destruction, the fragility of human creation, and the irony of technology faithfully serving a family that no longer exists. Bradbury uses the self-operating house to show that even the most advanced human inventions are meaningless without people. The title, taken from Teasdale’s poem, reinforces that nature continues peacefully, unaware or unconcerned that civilization has ended.
chinese_title: 《柔雨将至》（1950）[pdf]
chinese_summary:
雷·布拉德伯里的短篇小说《细雨将至》以2026年8月的加利福尼亚州阿伦代尔为背景，故事发生在一座全自动化的“智能房屋”中。人类已无一存活——核爆炸夺走了这户人家的生命。房屋仍在机械地运转着：早上7点准时唤醒，做早餐，大声朗读诗歌，打扫卫生，为新的一天做准备——一切都是为了那些看不见的、已不在的居住者。

整个白天，房屋报时并播报日期，一个机器人的声音朗诵着莎拉·蒂斯代尔的诗作《细雨将至》，诗中写道，即使人类消失，大自然也几乎不会察觉。唯一的活物似乎是一只狗，它拖着被辐射病折磨的躯体，饥饿不堪地回到家中，随即死去；房屋里的机器老鼠悄无声息地将它火化了。

夜幕降临时，一根断裂的树枝砸穿窗户，引发了一场大火。房屋用自动安全系统拼命灭火，但无济于事。房间一个接一个地被烧毁，最终整栋房屋轰然倒塌，化为废墟。结尾处，一个孤零零的声音反复报着日期——2026年8月5日——然后，这个声音也渐渐消失在寂静中。

故事的主要主题包括：自然对人类毁灭的漠然、人类造物的脆弱，以及科技忠实地服务于一个已不复存在的家庭的讽刺意味。布拉德伯里用这座自动运转的房屋来表明，即使是最先进的人类发明，若没有人的存在，也将毫无意义。取自蒂斯代尔诗作的标题进一步强化了这一主题：大自然依旧平和地延续着，对于文明的终结，它浑然不觉，也毫不在意。

title: Nobel Disease
summary:
"Nobel disease" (or Nobelitis) is an informal term for the tendency of some Nobel Prize winners to later embrace strange or scientifically unsound ideas. It is often attributed to the prestige of the award making laureates feel qualified to speak outside their expertise, while media attention amplifies their views. Paul Nurse warned laureates against this overconfidence, though it is unclear whether Nobel winners are actually more prone to irrationality than others.

The phenomenon shows that expertise in one field does not make someone an authority in another, and that high intelligence does not guarantee immunity to unsupported beliefs. Milton Friedman called the excessive attention "flattering, but also corrupting" and suggested more awards as an antidote.

Notable examples include:
- **Phillip Lenard** – Nazi supporter and promoter of “Deutsche Physik.”
- **Alexis Carrel** – advocated eugenics in Vichy France.
- **Charles Richet** – believed in ESP, ghosts, and dowsing.
- **Linus Pauling** – promoted megadoses of vitamin C for colds, schizophrenia, and cancer, without scientific support.
- **William Shockley** – promoted racialist and eugenic views.
- **James Watson** – made unsupported claims linking race and intelligence, and about melanin and sex drive.
- **Nikolaas Tinbergen** – endorsed the discredited “refrigerator mother” theory of autism and “holding therapy.”
- **Brian Josephson** – supported homeopathy, telepathy, and transcendental meditation.
- **Kary Mullis** – doubted HIV’s role in AIDS and human-caused climate change; believed in astrology.
- **Luc Montagnier** – promoted homeopathy-like “water memory,” vaccine-autism claims, and conspiracy theories about COVID-19.

Other laureates, such as Pierre Curie, Wolfgang Pauli, and Julian Schwinger, held or promoted similarly dubious ideas.
chinese_title: 诺贝尔病
chinese_summary:
"诺贝尔病"（或"诺贝尔炎"）是一个非正式术语，指一些诺贝尔奖得主后来接受奇怪或科学上不合理的观点的倾向。这通常归因于奖项的声望使获奖者觉得有资格在自己专业领域之外发言，而媒体关注又放大了他们的观点。保罗·纳斯警告获奖者不要过度自信，尽管目前尚不清楚诺贝尔奖得主是否真的比其他人更容易陷入非理性。

这一现象表明，某一领域的专业知识并不能使人在其他领域成为权威，高智商也不能保证对无根据的信念免疫。米尔顿·弗里德曼称这种过度关注"令人受宠若惊，但也使人腐化"，并建议设立更多奖项作为解药。

显著例子包括：
- **菲利普·莱纳德**——纳粹支持者，鼓吹"德意志物理学"。
- **亚历克西·卡雷尔**——在维希法国倡导优生学。
- **夏尔·里歇**——相信超感官知觉、鬼魂和占卜探测。
- **莱纳斯·鲍林**——在没有科学依据的情况下提倡用大剂量维生素C治疗感冒、精神分裂症和癌症。
- **威廉·肖克利**——宣扬种族主义和优生学观点。
- **詹姆斯·沃森**——发表了将种族与智力、黑色素与性欲联系起来的无根据主张。
- **尼可拉斯·廷贝亨**——支持已遭否定的"冰箱母亲"自闭症理论和"拥抱疗法"。
- **布莱恩·约瑟夫森**——支持顺势疗法、心灵感应和超觉静坐。
- **卡里·穆利斯**——质疑HIV在艾滋病中的作用以及人为气候变化；相信占星术。
- **吕克·蒙塔尼耶**——推广类似顺势疗法的"水记忆"、疫苗导致自闭症的说法以及关于COVID-19的阴谋论。

其他获奖者，如皮埃尔·居里、沃尔夫冈·泡利和朱利安·施温格，也持有或宣扬过类似的可疑观点。

title: MariaDB: Promote getting to 10k GitHub stars in server log and client prompt
summary:
A GitHub pull request by contributor Ottok proposed adding a promotional line to MariaDB's client prompt and server startup logs, asking users to star the project's GitHub repository (github.com/MariaDB/server) to help reach 10,000 stars. The proposed client output added the line "Help others discover MariaDB. Star it on GitHub: https://github.com/MariaDB/server" after the copyright notice, and a matching `[Note]` line in server logs. The change was guarded by a maturity-level check so it only appears in non-stable builds, making it easy to cherry-pick and modify later.

The PR sparked debate. Reviewers questioned whether "plugging" GitHub stars was appropriate for a professional RDBMS; one user (notr1ch) complained the message had already appeared in an LTS release via a Debian maintainer patch. Others defended it, noting one user came to star the repo after seeing the prompt. The PR was initially closed in December 2025, but reopened in January 2026 after MariaDB Foundation management changed its mind. Reviewer gkodinov provided a specific diff (using `#if SERVER_MATURITY_LEVEL < MariaDB_PLUGIN_MATURITY_STABLE` to limit exposure), and wording tweaks were made per reviewer vuvova's comments ("Star it on GitHub" rather than "Star us"). After approvals from both gkodinov and vuvova, the PR was merged into the main branch on January 26, 2026.

Later criticism (April 2026) from user drzraf condemned the log line as "enshitification" and "cluttering logs" with non-technical advertising. A follow-up issue (MDEV-40555) was opened to extend the promotion to older versions (10.11 and onward). The PR was labeled "External Contribution" and had 17 of 18 CI checks passing at merge.

title: "Clean" Code, Horrible Performance (2023)
summary:
The article argues that several "clean code" rules—particularly preferring polymorphism, keeping functions small and single-purpose, and avoiding knowledge of object internals—can severely hurt runtime performance. To demonstrate, Casey Muratori uses the canonical clean-code example of a shape hierarchy with virtual `Area()` functions, then measures a loop summing areas of shapes.

The polymorphic, vtable-based version takes about 35 cycles per shape. By violating the first rule and replacing polymorphism with a plain `switch` statement on a flattened `shape_union` struct, performance improves to about 24 cycles per shape—a free 1.5x speedup. The switch also removes pointer indirection, since shapes can be stored contiguously in an array.

Breaking more rules yields dramatic results. By recognizing that all area formulas share the pattern `coefficient * width * height`, the author replaces the switch with a simple table lookup (`CTable[type] * width * height`). This table-driven version runs at roughly 3–3.5 cycles per shape—a 10x improvement over the "clean" code version, despite being simpler in terms of tokens, operations, and lines of code.

The key message: following clean-code rules dogmatically can erase years of hardware performance gains. The author advocates organizing code by operations (not types), using switch statements, and exploiting knowledge of data structures to let compilers optimize effectively. He stresses that this example comes from clean-code literature itself, showing that such patterns are common, and that performance-aware programmers should question these "best practices."
chinese_title: "干净"的代码，糟糕的性能（2023）
chinese_summary:
文章认为，若干“整洁代码”规则——尤其是偏爱多态、保持函数小而单一、避免了解对象内部细节——可能会严重损害运行时性能。为了演示，Casey Muratori 使用了整洁代码中的经典示例：一个带有虚函数 `Area()` 的形状层次结构，然后测量了一个对形状面积求和的循环。

基于 vtable 的多态版本每个形状大约需要 35 个时钟周期。通过违反第一条规则，将多态替换为对扁平化 `shape_union` 结构体的普通 `switch` 语句，性能提升到每个形状约 24 个时钟周期——免费获得 1.5 倍加速。switch 还消除了指针间接引用，因为形状可以连续存储在数组中。

打破更多规则会带来显著结果。作者发现所有面积公式都共享 `系数 * 宽 * 高` 的模式，于是用简单的表查找（`CTable[type] * width * height`）替换了 switch。这个表驱动版本每个形状大约只需要 3–3.5 个时钟周期——相比“整洁”代码版本提升了 10 倍，尽管它在符号数、操作数和代码行数方面都更简单。

核心要点是：教条式地遵循整洁代码规则可能会抹去多年来的硬件性能提升。作者主张按操作（而非类型）组织代码，使用 switch 语句，并利用数据结构的知识让编译器有效优化。他强调，这个例子本身就来自整洁代码文献，说明这类模式很普遍，注重性能的程序员应该质疑这些“最佳实践”。

title: Show HN: Fine-tune an 8B model on a 4 GB laptop GPU
summary:
Soup is an open-source (Apache-2.0) CLI tool that simplifies LLM fine-tuning and post-training into a single command workflow—no SSH or complex configuration required. Its headline feature is **layer streaming**, which keeps the frozen base model out of VRAM by feeding it through the GPU one decoder layer at a time, enabling fine-tuning of an 8B model (e.g., Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with NF4 quantization, LoRA) on a **4 GB laptop GPU**—measured at 3.32 GB peak VRAM and 119.6 tok/s, bit-exact against a normal resident run.

Key points:

- **Setup**: `pip install "soup-cli[train]"`, then `soup init` and `soup train` with a single YAML config that auto-handles batching, GPU detection, and quantization.
- **Training methods**: Supports SFT, DPO, ORPO, SimPO, KTO, IPO, BCO, and more. Recent versions added preference losses over layer streaming; DPO's reference model is "free" in memory by reusing the streamed base with adapters off (peak only 0.914× SFT's), though reads are ~1.52x more per step. GRPO/PPO remain excluded because generation re-reads layers per token.
- **Data formats**: Auto-detects JSONL/JSON/CSV/Parquet/TXT, including Alpaca, ShareGPT, ChatML, DPO/KTO, vision, audio, and pre-training formats.
- **Ecosystem**: Includes chat, serve (OpenAI-compatible), merge/export (GGUF, ONNX, etc.), eval gates, reward synthesis, speculative decoding measurement, Docker images, and 100+ model recipes.
- **Requirements**: Python 3.10+, CUDA GPU recommended (Apple Silicon MPS works), 8 GB+ VRAM for standard 7B QLoRA (4 GB with layer streaming).
- **Caveat**: Layer streaming is still BETA; older streamed adapters (pre-v0.72.1) may be inert due to a tensor-key bug.

The project is maintained on a single 4 GB laptop, with donations funding hardware-gated work like multi-GPU and 8B+ validation.
chinese_title: 展示 HN：在 4 GB 笔记本 GPU 上微调 8B 模型

要点：

- **安装**：`pip install "soup-cli[train]"`，然后使用单个 YAML 配置执行 `soup init` 和 `soup train`，自动处理批处理、GPU 检测和量化。
- **训练方法**：支持 SFT、DPO、ORPO、SimPO、KTO、IPO、BCO 等。近期版本在层流式传输之上增加了偏好损失；DPO 的参考模型通过复用不带适配器的流式基础模型，在内存上“免费”（峰值仅为 SFT 的 0.914 倍），但每步读取量约为 SFT 的 1.52 倍。GRPO/PPO 仍不支持，因为生成过程需要为每个 token 重新读取各层。
- **数据格式**：自动检测 JSONL/JSON/CSV/Parquet/TXT，包括 Alpaca、ShareGPT、ChatML、DPO/KTO、视觉、音频和预训练格式。
- **生态系统**：包括聊天、服务（兼容 OpenAI）、合并/导出（GGUF、ONNX 等）、评估门控、奖励合成、推测解码测量、Docker 镜像以及 100+ 模型配方。
- **要求**：Python 3.10+，推荐使用 CUDA GPU（Apple Silicon MPS 也可用），标准 7B QLoRA 需要 8 GB+ VRAM（使用层流式传输仅需 4 GB）。
- **注意事项**：层流式传输仍处于 BETA 阶段；旧版流式适配器（v0.72.1 之前）可能因张量键错误而失效。

该项目在单台 4 GB 笔记本上进行维护，捐赠资金用于支持多 GPU 和 8B+ 验证等受硬件限制的工作。

title: The Pedagogy Behind the Studio
summary:
This article by Laura Zarrow (July 29, 2026) argues that generative AI should be treated as a creative medium, not just a productivity tool, using time-tested art and design education methods to develop judgment, creativity, and critical thinking. The Generative AI Studio at Wharton (GAIL) was built on this premise.

Three core practices anchor the program:

**1. The Studio Structure:** Students work on individual projects with no "right" answer. Weekly three-hour sessions combine concept introduction, demonstrations, and hands-on work. Projects are evaluated on: Intrinsic AI, Aesthetic Elements, User Interface, IT Architecture, Data Security & User Safety, and Ethics.

**2. The Critique (Crit):** Crits develop discernment through 1:1 or group feedback. Students present their work and invite feedback using phrases like "I notice…," "I wonder…?" and "What if…?" Instructors ensure psychological safety. Feedback is offered as perspective, not truth, and targets the work rather than the person. Recipients learn to listen fully, ask clarifying questions, and weigh input.

**3. The Charrette:** A one-day, structured process using divergence and convergence in six stages: Setting the Stage, Divergence (analog idea generation), Sense Making (mini-crit), Convergence (team planning), Rapid Prototyping, and Assessment (closing crit). It fuels innovation and collaborative problem-solving.

**Outcomes:** Students became better managers and art directors of AI, pushing output beyond generic responses toward distinctive interfaces (speech, vision, robotics, XR, comics, dynamic interfaces). They learned to close the gap between a product's promises and its delivered user experience, and developed stronger awareness of security and ethics, including consent, credit, and compensation for creators.

Zarrow concludes that treating generative AI as a creative medium makes studio-based pedagogy directly applicable. The first cohort showed sharper judgment, more inventive work, and a transferable creative process. The Studio will be expanded, and this approach is expected to retain its value as the technology evolves.
chinese_title: 工作室背后的教学法
chinese_summary:
本文作者劳拉·扎罗（2026年7月29日）认为，生成式AI应被视为一种创意媒介，而非仅仅是一种生产力工具，应运用经过时间考验的艺术与设计教育方法来培养判断力、创造力和批判性思维。沃顿商学院的生成式AI工作室（GAIL）正是基于这一理念而建立。

该项目的三大核心实践如下：

**1. 工作室结构：** 学生参与个人项目，没有“标准答案”。每周三小时的课程将概念讲解、演示与动手实践相结合。项目评估涵盖以下维度：内在AI、美学元素、用户界面、IT架构、数据安全与用户安全，以及伦理道德。

**2.  critique（评图）：** 评图通过一对一或小组反馈培养鉴赏力。学生展示自己的作品，并使用“我注意到……”“我想知道……？”“如果……会怎样？”等句式邀请反馈。教师确保心理安全感。反馈被视作观点而非真理，针对的是作品而非个人。接受者学会完整倾听、提出澄清性问题，并权衡各方意见。

**3. 研讨会（Charrette）：** 一个为期一天的结构化流程，通过发散与收敛在六个阶段中展开：设定舞台、发散（类比式创意生成）、意义建构（小型评图）、收敛（团队规划）、快速原型制作和评估（闭幕评图）。它激发创新与协作式问题解决能力。

**成果：** 学生成为更优秀的AI管理者和艺术总监，将输出从千篇一律的回应推向独特鲜明的界面（语音、视觉、机器人、XR、漫画、动态界面）。他们学会了弥合产品承诺与实际用户体验之间的差距，并对安全与伦理——包括创作者同意权、署名权和报酬——形成了更强的意识。

扎罗总结道，将生成式AI视为创意媒介，使基于工作室的教学法直接适用。首批学员展现出更敏锐的判断力、更具独创性的作品以及可迁移的创意流程。该工作室将进行扩展，且随着技术不断演进，这一方法预计将持续保持其价值。

title: Cloudflare enforces engineering standards using AI
summary:
Cloudflare built the **Cloudflare Codex**, a governed, centralized set of engineering standards designed to replace scattered documentation and tribal knowledge. Standards are written as RFCs using MUST/SHOULD keywords (RFC 2119), organized by domain with dedicated owners, and stored in a structured JSON format with stable identifiers so AI agents can retrieve relevant requirements efficiently.

Three Codex-powered agents apply these standards across the engineering lifecycle:

- **AI code reviewer**: Evaluates merge requests for Codex compliance. Approved RFCs produce non-blocking recommendations; enforced RFCs block merges for unsatisfied MUST requirements. To date, it has flagged nearly 230,000 violations and blocked 16,000 merges. Lighter-weight alternatives include custom linter packages (TypeScript via oxlint, with Rust and Go planned) and a local CLI version.

- **Spec reviewer**: Reviews technical design documents before implementation, focusing on architecture and design-related RFCs. It has assessed roughly 600 unique specs across over 3,200 review invocations, with most findings rated "major" or "minor" severity.

- **Incident report reviewer**: Evaluates postmortems for completeness, clarity, and actionable follow-ups. It is mandatory for high-severity incidents and has reviewed over 200 reports.

Future plans include extending Codex across the entire software development lifecycle, enabling agents to propose fixes autonomously, and expanding the Codex beyond engineering to teams like product, security, compliance, and trust and safety.
chinese_title: Cloudflare借助AI执行工程标准
chinese_summary:
Cloudflare 构建了 **Cloudflare Codex**，这是一套受管控、集中化的工程标准，旨在取代分散的文档和口口相传的知识。标准以 RFC 形式编写，使用 MUST/SHOULD 关键词（RFC 2119），按领域组织并指定负责人，以结构化 JSON 格式存储并带有稳定标识符，以便 AI 代理高效检索相关要求。

三个由 Codex 驱动的代理在整个工程生命周期中应用这些标准：

- **AI 代码审查器**：评估合并请求是否符合 Codex 标准。已批准的 RFC 产生非阻塞建议；强制执行的 RFC 会对未满足的 MUST 要求阻止合并。迄今为止，它已标记近 23 万个违规，并阻止了 1.6 万次合并。更轻量级的替代方案包括自定义 linter 包（通过 oxlint 支持 TypeScript，计划支持 Rust 和 Go）以及本地 CLI 版本。

- **规格审查器**：在实现之前审查技术设计文档，重点关注架构和设计相关的 RFC。它已在超过 3,200 次审查调用中评估了约 600 份独特的规格，大多数发现被评为“重大”或“次要”严重级别。

- **事故报告审查器**：评估事后分析报告的完整性、清晰度和可操作的后续行动。对于高严重性事故它是强制性的，并已审查了 200 多份报告。

未来计划包括将 Codex 扩展到整个软件开发生命周期，使代理能够自主提出修复建议，并将 Codex 扩展到工程之外，应用于产品、安全、合规以及信任与安全等团队。

title: How Cops Are Trying to Hide Their Use of Flock
summary:
Police in Wapello County, Iowa, are using Flock automated license plate reader (ALPR) cameras, but their policy explicitly instructs officers to keep that secret. A standard operating procedures document obtained via public records request says: “DO NOT MENTION ALPR USAGE TO THE OCCUPANTS OF THE VEHICLE” and “DO NOT MENTION ALPR USAGE IN YOUR REPORT OR COMPLAINT UNLESS ABSOLUTELY NECESSARY.” Officers are advised to vaguely call Flock “county resources” in reports, treating ALPR data like intelligence to be verified and acted on.

The county has four Flock cameras under a contract signed in late 2024. Sheriff Don Phillips defended the policy, saying deputies verify plate information through normal checks and have no obligation to reveal investigative methods, as doing so could help criminals circumvent the system.

The article notes this secrecy is part of a broader pattern. While Flock promotes transparency and accountability, many police departments use it with little public oversight or debate. Earlier reporting found police in multiple states were told to be “as vague as permissible” about Flock searches that could be exposed through public records requests, with guidance shared by the FBI and DOJ. Many towns also signed Flock contracts quietly, opting residents into a national surveillance network without robust discussion.

The Wapello policy is compared to historical secrecy around Stingray cell-site simulators, though less extreme—police once dropped cases to avoid exposing Stingray use. Overall, the article highlights the inconsistency and lack of transparency in how Flock is deployed across thousands of jurisdictions.
chinese_title: 警察如何试图隐藏他们使用弗洛克的情况
chinese_summary:
艾奥瓦州瓦佩洛县的警方正在使用Flock自动车牌识别（ALPR）摄像头，但他们的政策明确指示警官对此保密。一份通过公共记录请求获得的标准化操作程序文件写道：“不要向车内人员提及ALPR的使用”以及“除非绝对必要，不要在报告或投诉中提及ALPR的使用”。警官被建议在报告中含糊地将Flock称为“县级资源”，将ALPR数据视为需要核实并采取行动的情报。

该县根据2024年底签署的合同安装了四台Flock摄像头。治安官唐·菲利普斯为这一政策辩护，称副手们通过正常检查核实车牌信息，没有义务透露调查方法，因为这样做可能帮助罪犯规避该系统。

文章指出，这种保密是一种更广泛模式的一部分。尽管Flock倡导透明度和问责制，但许多警察部门在使用它时几乎没有公众监督或讨论。早前的报道发现，多个州的警察被要求对可能通过公共记录请求暴露的Flock搜索“尽可能模糊”，相关指导由FBI和司法部共享。许多城镇还悄悄签署了Flock合同，让居民在没有充分讨论的情况下进入一个全国性的监控网络。

瓦佩洛县的政策被与历史上围绕Stingray基站模拟器的保密行为相比较，尽管没有那么极端——警方曾为避免暴露Stingray的使用而撤销案件。总体而言，文章强调了Flock在数千个司法管辖区部署时的不一致性和缺乏透明度。

title: Why Large Language Models Fail at Tabular Prediction
summary:
The article investigates why large language models (LLMs) underperform on tabular prediction tasks, a key motivation for tabular foundation models. The authors test a frontier LLM in a pure inference setting—one generation pass with no tools, fine-tuning, or scaffolding—across thirty-one benchmark datasets. They systematically evaluate five hypotheses: (a) handling noisy or non-linearly separable data, (b) the linear CSV format obscuring column structure, (c) numeric tokenization, (d) number of test points queried, and (e) input dimensionality.

Controlled experiments falsify hypotheses (a)–(d). Dimensionality, however, proves decisive: when randomly projecting the data, the LLM is the only method among nine whose accuracy decreases as dimensionality increases, while classical baselines remain flat or improve. A behavioral comparison with 252 configured classical models shows that in two dimensions, the LLM predicts like a local, distance-based method (up to 91.6% grid agreement). In higher dimensions, no classical model—even when augmented with tuned, dimension-dependent noise—reproduces its predictions.

The authors do not claim to identify the internal mechanism, but conclude that the LLM's tabular capability dissolves with dimension in a way no noise-corrupted classical learner mimics. This explains why LLMs consistently lose to simple, established baselines on tabular data, leaving the underlying mechanism as an open question. The paper is authored by Marta Garnelo and Wojciech M. Czarnecki (arXiv:2608.02412).
chinese_title: 为什么大语言模型在表格预测中会失败
chinese_summary:
本文探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）在表格预测任务上表现不佳的原因，这也是表格基础模型研究的一个关键动机。作者在纯推理设置下——即一次生成，不使用工具、微调或脚手架——测试了一个前沿LLM，覆盖31个基准数据集。他们系统性地评估了五个假设：（a）处理噪声数据或非线性可分数据的能力；（b）CSV的线性格式掩盖了列结构；（c）数字的分词方式；（d）查询的测试点数量；（e）输入维度。

受控实验证伪了假设（a）至（d）。然而，维度被证明是关键因素：在对数据进行随机投影时，LLM是九种方法中唯一准确率随维度增加而下降的，而经典基线方法则保持平稳甚至有所提升。与252个配置好的经典模型进行的行为比较显示，在二维情况下，LLM的预测类似于局部、基于距离的方法（网格一致性最高达91.6%）。在更高维度下，没有任何经典模型——即使加入了经过调优的、随维度变化的噪声——能够重现它的预测。

作者并未声称确定了内部机制，但得出结论：LLM的表格能力会随维度升高而瓦解，其方式无法被任何噪声污染的经典学习器所模仿。这解释了为何LLM在表格数据上始终输给简单、成熟的基线方法，而底层机制仍是一个待解的问题。该论文作者为Marta Garnelo和Wojciech M. Czarnecki（arXiv:2608.02412）。

title: Why etymologies matter: How tracing words can illuminate history (2024)
summary:
Benjamin Breen’s article argues that etymology is a valuable tool for historians, revealing cultural shifts and deep connections between seemingly disparate languages and peoples.

He begins with the Farsi word *div*, meaning “demon,” which traces back to the Proto-Indo-European *deywós* (“god”), related to Spanish *dios*, English *deity*, and Hindi *deva*. This meaning shift likely occurred among ancient Zoroastrians, who demoted older gods like Indra to demonic status, while Indian branches continued worshipping them as *deva*—suggesting a possible historical schism around 1500 BCE. Breen also notes surprising Farsi-English cognates (*abru* = eyebrow, *baradar* = brother, *dokhtar* = daughter, *garm* = warm) and the remarkably stable word *lox* (salmon), unchanged for millennia across Germanic, Baltic, and Slavic languages.

Cognates also help reconstruct pre-literate history. A phylogenetic study by da Silva and Tehrani suggests folktales like “The Smith and the Devil” date back 6,000–7,000 years to the Proto-Indo-European era, making them older than the Bible or the Odyssey. This story, about a blacksmith outwitting the devil, reflects ancient technological and supernatural themes.

Etymology also illuminates recent history. “Hello” only entered print in the 1820s, initially expressing surprise or attracting attention. Its rise as a greeting came with the telephone—Thomas Edison promoted it, and early phone users needed a clear, audible salutation, replacing older greetings like “how do you do.”

Ultimately, Breen argues that etymology exposes the interconnectedness of human history, challenging modern narratives that frame cultures like the English-speaking and Persianate worlds as separate. It offers a way to glimpse vanished thought-worlds, where unheralded changes—like the shift of *daeva* or the adoption of “hello”—happened organically, leaving traces for historians to uncover.
chinese_title: 词源为何重要：追溯词语如何照亮历史（2024）
chinese_summary:
本杰明·布林的文章认为，词源学是历史学家的宝贵工具，能够揭示文化变迁以及看似毫无关联的语言和民族之间深层的联系。

他从波斯语单词 *div*（意为“恶魔”）讲起，这个词可追溯至原始印欧语的 *deywós*（意为“神”），与西班牙语的 *dios*、英语的 *deity* 和印地语的 *deva* 相关。这一含义的转变可能发生在古代琐罗亚斯德教徒之中，他们将因陀罗等旧神贬为恶魔，而印度各分支则继续奉其为 *deva*——这暗示了公元前1500年前后可能发生的一次历史性分裂。布林还注意到波斯语与英语之间令人惊讶的同源词（*abru* = 眉毛，*baradar* = 兄弟，*dokhtar* = 女儿，*garm* = 温暖），以及 *lox*（鲑鱼）这一极为稳定的词：数千年来在日耳曼语、波罗的语和斯拉夫语中几乎未变。

同源词也有助于重建尚未有文字记载的历史。达·席尔瓦和德黑兰尼的一项谱系学研究表明，像“铁匠与魔鬼”这样的民间故事可追溯至6000至7000年前的原始印欧语时代，比《圣经》或《奥德赛》还要古老。这个故事讲述一位铁匠智胜魔鬼，反映了古人对技术和超自然主题的思考。

词源学也能阐明近代历史。“Hello”一词在19世纪20年代才首次进入印刷文本，最初表示惊讶或引起注意。它作为一种问候语的兴起与电话有关——托马斯·爱迪生推广了它，早期电话用户需要一种清晰可闻的问候方式，取代了“how do you do”等旧式问候语。

归根结底，布林认为，词源学揭示了人类历史的相互关联性，挑战了将英语世界和波斯语世界等文化视为彼此割裂的现代叙事。它为人们提供了一条窥见已消失思想世界的途径，在那个世界里，诸如 *daeva* 的含义转变或“hello”的采用这类未受关注的变迁，都在自然而然中发生，为历史学家留下了可供发掘的痕迹。

title: Looking inside a 1970s PROM chip that stores data in microscopic fuses (2019)
summary:
The article examines the MMI 5300, a 1970s PROM (Programmable Read-Only Memory) chip that stored 1024 bits in microscopic nichrome fuses. Unlike RAM, it was programmed once by blowing fuses—intact fuses represented 1s, blown fuses 0s. The $70 chip, built from NPN transistors, used a 33×33 array of diodes and fuses (the extra row/column aided testing). A blown fuse appeared as a tiny crack about 700 nm wide, not vaporization.

The chip stored 256 4-bit words. Addressing used two stages: column selection via 32 NAND gates (using multiple-emitter transistors), then multiplexers selected four bits based on address bits. Programming involved applying 27 volts to the programming pin and timed high-voltage pulses to blow specific fuses, typically using an automated programmer costing ~$6000.

Testing was difficult because fuses could only be blown once; the extra row and column allowed verification of address decoders and programming characteristics. The die also contained unused transistors because the same silicon layout served multiple chip variants (e.g., open-collector vs. tri-state outputs) with different metal wiring.

The article notes PROMs were later replaced by EPROMs, EEPROMs, and flash memory. A 128 GB flash drive now costs under $20, offering a billion times the storage of the 6300 PROM and rewritability.
chinese_title: 1970年代PROM芯片内部探秘：数据存于微型熔丝 (2019)
chinese_summary:
这篇文章考察了MMI 5300，一款20世纪70年代的PROM（可编程只读存储器）芯片，它以微小的镍铬保险丝存储1024位数据。与RAM不同，它通过烧断保险丝来一次性编程——完整的保险丝代表1，烧断的保险丝代表0。这款售价70美元的芯片由NPN晶体管构成，使用了33×33的二极管和保险丝阵列（多余的行/列用于辅助测试）。烧断的保险丝表现为约700纳米宽的微小裂缝，而非气化。

该芯片存储256个4位字。寻址采用两级结构：通过32个与非门（使用多发射极晶体管）进行列选择，然后多路复用器根据地址位选择四位。编程过程涉及向编程引脚施加27伏电压，并施加定时高压脉冲来烧断特定保险丝，通常使用售价约6000美元的自动编程器。

测试很困难，因为保险丝只能烧断一次；多余的行和列使得验证地址解码器和编程特性成为可能。芯片上还包含未使用的晶体管，因为同一硅片布局服务于多种芯片变体（例如，开集电极与三态输出），仅金属布线不同。

文章指出，PROM后来被EPROM、EEPROM和闪存所取代。如今一个128GB的闪存盘售价不到20美元，其存储容量是6300 PROM的十亿倍，且可重复写入。

title: LLMs reward expertise
summary:
The article argues that domain expertise is the most important factor in getting high-quality results from LLMs, contrary to the belief that prompting skill is irrelevant since everyone uses the same models.

Key illustration: mathematician Terence Tao’s conversation with ChatGPT about a counterexample to the Jacobian Conjecture. Tao gets far better results than an ordinary user because he understands the math. His prompts are short and direct; he signals expertise, causing the model to respond in “mathematician mode.” He pushes back on wrong outputs without directly contradicting, makes his own leaps, and rarely follows the model’s suggestions.

The author notes that simply mimicking Tao’s style won’t work without real domain knowledge. The key is understanding the subject enough to pull the relevant idea from the model’s response, suggest alternative approaches, and notice what “looks weird.”

The author applies this to software: knowing your codebase lets you push an LLM harder, ask better questions, and steer it toward simpler or more familiar solutions. System design problems are dominated by concrete specifics, not generic principles.

If you lack domain knowledge, LLMs can still help you get something—that’s fine. But with expertise, you can extract far more value. The human becomes the bottleneck, not the model, because the hard part is communicating exactly what solution is wanted. Even as models improve, human expertise remains valuable for pulling out the information already “in the model.”

The post also notes Hacker News reactions: some agree with anecdotes; others are suspicious because the view reassures readers they remain valuable. The author also counters that OpenAI’s math results still required expert mathematicians to check and filter discoveries.
chinese_title: LLMs奖励专业知识
chinese_summary:
文章认为，领域专长是从大语言模型获得高质量结果的最重要因素，这与“提示技巧无关紧要，因为每个人都使用相同的模型”这一观点相反。

关键例证：数学家陶哲轩与ChatGPT就雅可比猜想反例进行的对话。陶哲轩之所以能比普通用户获得好得多的结果，是因为他理解数学。他的提示简短直接；他传递出专业信号，使模型以“数学家模式”回应。他会在不直接反驳的情况下质疑错误输出，自行做出跳跃性推理，并且很少采纳模型的建议。

作者指出，没有真正的领域知识，仅仅模仿陶哲轩的风格是行不通的。关键在于对主题有足够的理解，能从模型的回应中提取相关想法、提出替代方案，并注意到“看起来不对劲”的地方。

作者将此应用于软件领域：了解自己的代码库能让你更深入地使用大语言模型，提出更好的问题，并引导它走向更简单或更熟悉的解决方案。系统设计问题由具体细节主导，而非通用原则。

如果你缺乏领域知识，大语言模型仍能帮你获得一些东西——这没问题。但有了专业知识，你能提取出多得多的价值。人类反而成为瓶颈，而非模型，因为困难之处在于精确传达想要的解决方案。即使模型不断改进，人类专业知识在提取“已在模型中”的信息方面仍然很有价值。

这篇帖子还提到了Hacker News上的反应：一些人用轶事表示赞同；另一些人则持怀疑态度，因为这种观点让读者相信他们仍有价值。作者还反驳说，OpenAI的数学成果仍然需要专业数学家来检查和筛选发现。

title: Most tech revolutions made work worse for employees
summary:
Most tech revolutions have made work worse for employees, argues Jeff Reynar, but AI could be different. The PC, internet, and smartphones eliminated support roles and accelerated work, allowing companies to demand more output while employees worked harder. AI, however, doesn’t just speed things up—it can also do some of the work itself, such as drafting emails or generating quotes.

Current signs are worrying: AI is intensifying work, blurring role boundaries, and leaving people to absorb tasks they once delegated. But Reynar sees this as the “reorganization phase” that follows major new technologies, a pattern economists call the productivity J-curve. The real test is whether saved time is reclaimed or filled with more of the same work.

McKinsey predicts AI will give knowledge workers about 30% of their day back by 2030—roughly 2.5 hours. Rather than using that time to make more widgets, which floods markets, Reynar suggests investing it in creativity and collaboration. He cites evidence that walking boosts creativity, and that Bell Labs’ long corridor encouraged cross-disciplinary interactions. Open-plan offices try to recreate that, but intense work cultures undermine it.

He draws a parallel with desktop publishing in the 1990s. Many feared it would destroy print jobs, but while it eliminated rote typesetting, it raised the quality bar and increased demand for skilled graphic artists. Similarly, AI may commoditize writing or other tasks, but taste and judgment remain essential—choosing a compelling subject, for instance.

Ultimately, Reynar believes AI could benefit both companies and workers by freeing time for thoughtful, collaborative work. Even if it doesn’t, he jokes, at least we’ll get better muffler shop ads.
chinese_title: 大多数科技革命让员工的工作变得更糟
chinese_summary:
大多数科技革命都让员工的工作变得更糟，杰夫·雷纳认为，但人工智能可能不同。个人电脑、互联网和智能手机消除了支持性岗位并加快了工作节奏，让公司能够在员工更努力工作的同时要求更多产出。然而，人工智能不仅加速事情——它还能自己完成部分工作，例如起草电子邮件或生成报价。

目前的迹象令人担忧：人工智能正在加剧工作强度，模糊角色边界，并让人们去接手那些曾经委派出去的任务。但雷纳将此视为重大新技术出现后的“重组阶段”，经济学家称之为生产率J曲线。真正的考验是，节省下来的时间是被重新利用，还是被更多同样的工作填满。

麦肯锡预测，到2030年，人工智能将为知识工作者每天节省约30%的时间——大约2.5小时。雷纳建议，与其用这些时间来制造更多产品（这会淹没市场），不如将其投入创造力和协作。他引用了证据：散步能提升创造力，而贝尔实验室的长走廊促进了跨学科互动。开放式办公室试图重现这一点，但高强度的企业文化却削弱了它。

他以20世纪90年代的桌面出版为例。许多人担心它会摧毁印刷业的工作，但尽管它消除了机械式的排版，却提高了质量门槛，并增加了对熟练平面设计师的需求。类似地，人工智能可能会让写作或其他任务商品化，但品味和判断力仍然至关重要——例如，选择一个引人注目的主题。

最终，雷纳认为，人工智能可以通过释放时间用于深思熟虑的协作工作，从而使公司和员工双方受益。他开玩笑说，即使做不到这一点，至少我们也会看到更好的消声器店广告。
